# B.K.S. Industries

> Premier Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacturer & Kitchen Setup Specialist in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Estd. 2010.

B.K.S. Industries (BKS Industries) is a factory-direct manufacturer of heavy-duty, commercial heavy-duty commercial kitchen equipment, kitchen exhaust ventilation systems, commercial refrigeration, and custom commercial grade fabrication for restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, bakeries, canteens, and institutional kitchens across Bangalore, Karnataka, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Pan-India.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.bksindustries.in/): BKS Industries homepage, factory overview, client portfolio, and commercial kitchen solutions.
- [About Us](https://www.bksindustries.in/about.html): Company background, factory manufacturing infrastructure, certified Heavy-Duty Commercial Grade food-grade standards, and client testimonials.
- [Products Catalog](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html): Full commercial kitchen equipment catalog with specifications, dimensions, features, and custom sizing options.
- [Turnkey Services](https://www.bksindustries.in/services.html): Turnkey commercial kitchen consulting, 2D/3D CAD layout design, LPG gas pipeline installation, ventilation exhaust ducting, and AMC maintenance contracts.
- [Completed Projects](https://www.bksindustries.in/projects.html): Showcase of completed commercial kitchen setup projects for hotels, cloud kitchens, bakeries, and food courts.
- [Commercial Kitchen Guides & Blog](https://www.bksindustries.in/blogs.html): In-depth commercial kitchen planning guides, equipment buying checklists, cost guides, and maintenance tips.
- [Contact & Factory Showroom](https://www.bksindustries.in/contact.html): Contact details, direct factory pricing inquiries, WhatsApp consultation, and Bangalore showroom location.

## Key Product Categories

- [Commercial Cooking Ranges](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html#cooking): Heavy-duty high pressure gas burners, Indian stockpot bhatti, Chinese wok burners with water rinse, continental ranges, dosa tawa plates, and tilting brat pans.
- [Kitchen Exhaust & Ventilation Systems](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html#exhaust): Heavy-Duty Commercial Grade kitchen exhaust hoods, baffle filters, centrifugal GI/SS ducting blowers, fresh air make-up systems, and fire damper integration.
- [Commercial Refrigeration & Cold Storage](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html#refrigeration): Upright 2/4-door vertical chillers and freezers (-18°C to +4°C), under-counter display chillers, prep tables, and blast chillers.
- [Custom Commercial Kitchen Fabrication](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html#fabrication): Heavy-duty commercial grade worktables with undershelves, pot washing 2/3 sink units, pass counters, wall shelves, and mobile tray racks.
- [Bakery & Snack Equipment](https://www.bksindustries.in/products.html#bakery): Industrial deck ovens, spiral dough mixers, planetary mixers, shawarma broilers, double tank electric deep fryers, and bulk idly steamers.
